newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM tells Ikeda to return to Tokyo from Lima.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM tells Ikeda to return to Tokyo from Lima.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto said on Sunday he had told Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda to leave Peru for home soon.
Hashomoto told reporters he "instructed" Ikeda to leave Lima at around 1400 GMT on Sunday.

Ikeda flew to Lima on Thursday as Japan's on-the-spot advisor in the crisis, two days after Marxist rebels seized the Japanese ambassador's residence during a party in honour of Emperoro Akihito's 63rd birthday.

During his stay in Lima, Ikeda held talks with Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori and Education Minister Domingo Palermo Cabrejos, who was acting as a negotiator for the release of the hundreds of people taken hostage.
Ikeda also met diplomats and consoled relatives of the dozens of Japanese diplomats and Peruvian-Japanese citizens held by the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA).
The Japanese group is one of the biggest being held.
